subject: Post-call recap: StackWise consolidation, RAG onboarding & renewal considerations
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Liu <sara@stackwise.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: StackWise consolidation, RAG onboarding & renewal considerations

Hi Sara / Luis —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned after the call. I’ve included the items Rishi and Laura will own for the next week.

Key pain points you shared
- Rising token spend across three different LLM vendors; inconsistent latency during peak ingest windows.
- Fragmented retrieval pipeline for RAG: multiple vector stores, duplicated embeddings, slow refresh cadence.
- Procurement timeline: renewal window opens in ~10 weeks; procurement needs an initial SOW + pricing line items to start negotiations.

Goals we agreed on
- Consolidate generation and embedding calls onto a single inference runtime (Redwood Dedicated or Private) to cut unit cost and simplify ops.
- Standardize embedding pipeline and migrate 1 of the 3 product teams to a shared RAG service as a pilot.
- Target 20–30% token cost reduction through batching, KV caching, and quantization (pilot metric).

What Redwood will deliver (next 7 business days)
1) Rishi: a sample billing/usage analysis and 90-day cost projection using your Q1 export (attached).
2) Laura: a short pilot plan for migrating the customer-care team to a shared RAG pipeline (scope, metric targets, rollback plan).
3) Connor: a Dedicated capacity sizing estimate and options (monthly reserved vs. burst).

Proposed timeline
- By 2027-05-31: internal draft of pilot SOW and cost projection sent to your procurement.
- Week of 2027-06-07: pilot kickoff (2–4 week validation window).
- By 2027-07-15: decision point for renewal/expanded Dedicated commit (aligned to your renewal window).

Immediate asks for StackWise
- Can you confirm who on your procurement/legal side should receive the draft SOW? (Luis, is that procurement@stackwise.ai?)
- Please confirm the three product teams using the three LLM vendors so Rishi can map traffic.

Attachments included: stackwise-usage-q1-aggregated.csv, redwood-proposal-v2.pdf

Thanks — I’ll follow up with separate messages for the SOW and pilot plan.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Sara Liu <sara@stackwise.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Luis Ortega <luis.ortega@stackwise.ai>, StackWise Procurement <procurement@stackwise.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: StackWise consolidation, RAG onboarding & renewal considerations

Thanks Naomi — this is helpful and captures the call nicely. A few clarifications: 

1) Procurement contact: yes, procurement@stackwise.ai (Luis is looped as legal lead).
2) Product teams: Customer Care (prod-customer), Knowledge Base (prod-knowledge), and Integrations (prod-integ). Customer Care is the priority for the pilot.
3) On metrics: 20–30% cost reduction looks realistic; we also want to track successful retrieval hit-rate improvements (target +15% to reduce calls).

Next steps from our side: procurement will review the SOW and come back with any commercial redlines. I’ll also share a short RAG diagram so you can see our current vector store topology. Expect that later today.

—Sara
Head of AI Platforms | StackWise
sara@stackwise.ai

- Draft the embedding migration checklist for the Customer Care team (schema mapping, embedding refresh cadence, golden prompt set).

If procurement wants a formal quote (line items, MRR vs committed tokens), Connor will prepare the Dedicated sizing and pricing options.

Thanks — Rishi

Thanks team — procurement reviewed the draft snapshot Rishi sent and procurement@stackwise.ai is good to receive the SOW and a formal quote. A couple of asks from legal/procurement before we proceed to an internal approval loop: 

- Please include a brief data-flow appendix in the SOW that states where embeddings and request logs will be stored, retention windows, and whether customer data will transit any third-party analytics.
- Can you add an option for a 12-month committed Dedicated tier and a 6-month pilot with a month-to-month burst option? We need clear cancellation and scaling terms.

If you can get the SOW + quote to procurement@stackwise.ai by Monday 2027-05-31, we’ll start a procurement/finance review next week and aim to have a commercial decision by mid-July.

Luis Ortega
Head of Procurement | StackWise
